name: Pizzeria il Paolo
kurzbeschreibung:
**Pizzeria il Paolo in Schwaz**

Welcome to **Pizzeria il Paolo** in the heart of **Schwaz**, where authentic Italian flavors meet Tyrolean charm. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this cozy spot invites you to savor freshly baked pizzas, handmade pasta, and crisp salads in a warm, rustic setting.

Whether you're craving a classic **Margherita**, a hearty **Diavola**, or a creative **Funghi e Tartufo**, every bite is crafted with passion. Pair your meal with a glass of fine Italian wine or a refreshing local beer—perfect for unwinding after exploring the stunning landscapes of **Tirol**.

Open daily for lunch and dinner, **Pizzeria il Paolo** is your go-to for a taste of Italy right in the middle of the Alps. Don’t miss their famous **Tiramisu** for dessert—pure indulgence!

Come for the food, stay for the atmosphere. **Benvenuti a Schwaz!**
